usanguk.definitionKo: 삼국 시대에 지금의 울릉도에 있던 나라. 512년에 신라에 합쳐졌다.
usanguk.englishDescription: A state during the Three Kingdoms period in Korea, used to be located in today's Ulleungdo Island and annexed into the Silla Kingdom in 512.

use improperly.definitionKo: 정해진 기준이 넘는 양을 함부로 사용하다.
use improperly.englishDescription: To use the quantity that exceeds the set limit.

used briquet.definitionKo: 연탄이 다 탄 뒤에 남은 재.
used briquet.englishDescription: Ashes left after a briquet burns.

usher.definitionKo: 어떤 사람을 그 사람이 잘 모르는 장소로 이끌거나 가고자 하는 곳까지 데려다 주다.
usher.englishDescription: To bring someone to a place that he/she does not know well or wants to go to.

uzbekistan.definitionKo: 중앙아시아에 있는 나라. 관개 농업이 발달하였으며 주요 생산물은 목화이다. 주민 대부분이 이슬람교도이다. 공용어는 우즈베크어이고 수도는 타슈켄트이다.
uzbekistan.englishDescription: A country located in Central Asia; it is known for advanced irrigation farming and as a major producer of cotton; most of its people are Muslims; its official language is Uzbek and its capital is Tashkent.

valve.definitionKo: 기체나 액체 등의 양이나 압력을 조절하는 장치.
valve.englishDescription: A device that controls the amount or pressure of gas or liquid.

valve.definitionKo: 심장이나 핏줄 속에서 피가 거꾸로 흐르는 것을 막는 막.
valve.englishDescription: A membrane keeping blood from running backward in one's heart or blood vessel.

vice president.definitionKo: 학급, 부서 등의 반에서 반장을 도와 반의 일을 맡아보는 직위. 또는 그런 사람.
vice president.englishDescription: A position in charge of helping the president with the handling of affairs in a class, student body, etc.; or the person who is in such a post.

vice president.definitionKo: 회사에서 사장 바로 아래의 지위. 또는 그 지위에 있는 사람.
vice president.englishDescription: The position below the president in a company, or a person in the position.

vice president.definitionKo: 일부 대통령 중심제 국가에서 대통령을 돕고 대통령이 없을 때에는 대통령의 역할를 대신 하기도 하는 직위. 또는 그런 직위에 있는 사람.
vice president.englishDescription: A position in a presidential government, which assists the president and substitutes for him/her when the office is vacant; a person in such a position.

violinist.englishDescription: A person who plays the violin professionally.

visit to one's ancestral grave.definitionKo: 조상의 산소에 가서 인사를 드리고 산소를 돌봄. 또는 그런 일.
visit to one's ancestral grave.englishDescription: The act of visiting and paying respects to one's ancestral grave and tending it, or such an act.

visual.englishDescription: A word that usually refers to a person's appearance.

ward.englishDescription: A room where a hospitalized patient stays.

ward.definitionKo: 병원 안에서 병의 종류나 환자의 성별 등에 따라 나누어 놓은 각각의 건물.
ward.englishDescription: One of the divisions in a hospital which have been divided according to the kinds of diseases or the genders of patients.

ward.definitionKo: 병을 고치기 위해 일정 기간 병원에 들어가 지내는 방.
ward.englishDescription: A room where one stays in a hospital for a certain period of time to have one's disease treated.

water and stones.englishDescription: A word that refers to water and stones collectively.

west gate.englishDescription: A gate located in the west of a castle.

western popular song.englishDescription: A popular song in the west.

western popular song.definitionKo: 오늘날 많은 사람들이 즐겨 부르는 통속적인 서양 음악.
western popular song.englishDescription: Contemporary, popular western music which many people enjoy singing.

wintering.definitionKo: 사람이나 동물, 식물 등이 여러 상태나 방법으로 겨울을 지내는 일.
wintering.englishDescription: An act of going through a winter season in various states or methods by people, animals, and plants.
The act of spending the winter.

wipe.englishDescription: To wipe away something that clings to the surface.
To wipe dirt or wet liquids with a mop.
To rub to eliminate dirty things.

wipe.definitionKo: 바닥이나 겉 부분의 지저분한 것을 문질러서 깎거나 닦아 내다.
wipe.englishDescription: To remove or wipe off something messy on a floor or surface by rubbing on it.

wipe.definitionKo: 물기나 먼지 등이 묻은 것을 닦아 없애다.
wipe.englishDescription: To wipe off moisture or dust, etc.

with a giggle.definitionKo: 웃음을 참지 못하여 가볍게 터져 나오는 웃음소리.
with a giggle.englishDescription: A word imitating light laughing sounds made after failing to hold back one's laughter.

with a giggle.definitionKo: 웃음을 참지 못하여 자꾸 가볍게 터져 나오는 웃음소리.
with a giggle.englishDescription: A word imitating the stifled, repeated laughing sounds after failing to hold back one's laughter.

with a giggle.definitionKo: 억지로 웃음을 참으면서 입속으로 웃는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a giggle.englishDescription: A word imitating the stifled, repeated laughing sounds after failing to hold back one's laughter or describing such a scene.

with a giggle.definitionKo: 웃음을 참지 못하여 입속에서 자꾸 새어 나오는 웃음소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a giggle.englishDescription: A word imitating the light, repeated laughing sounds at the corner of one's mouth, after failing to hold back one's laughter, or describing such a scene.

with a giggle.definitionKo: 웃음을 참지 못하여 자꾸 입속으로 웃는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a giggle.englishDescription: A word imitating the stifled, repeated laughing sounds, after failing to hold back one's laughter, or describing such a scene.

with a wriggle.definitionKo: 몸의 한 부분을 비틀거나 구부리며 움직이는 모양.
with a wriggle.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of moving while twisting or bending a body part.

with a wriggle.definitionKo: 덩치가 작은 것이 매달리거나 주저앉아서 팔이나 다리를 내저으며 자꾸 움직이는 모양.
with a wriggle.englishDescription: A word describing an animal, person, etc., with a small body hanging on something or sitting down while moving arms and legs.

with a wriggle.definitionKo: 덩치가 약간 작은 것이 매달리거나 주저앉아서 팔이나 다리를 내저으며 자꾸 움직이는 모양.
with a wriggle.englishDescription: A word describing an animal, person, etc., with a small body hanging on something or sitting down while moving arms and legs.

with coughs.definitionKo: 가슴 속에서 계속해서 울려 나오는 기침 소리.
with coughs.englishDescription: A word imitating repeated coughing sounds from deep in one's chest.

without sounds or rumors.englishDescription: In a secret and quiet manner.

work of makeup.definitionKo: 화장을 하여 실제보다 예쁘게 보이는 효과.
work of makeup.englishDescription: An effect achieved using makeup to make one look more beautiful than one really is.

working people.definitionKo: 일을 하고 받은 돈으로 생활을 하는 사람.
working people.englishDescription: A person who makes a living with money earned for doing some work.

working people.definitionKo: 일을 하고 받은 돈으로 생활을 하는 사람.
working people.englishDescription: A person who makes a living with money earned for doing some work.

working together.englishDescription: An act of joining forces to help each other.

zealously.englishDescription: With every sort of words or actions.

zzz.definitionKo: 잠이 들어 고르게 숨 쉬는 소리.
zzz.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound of breathing regularly while being asleep.

zzz.definitionKo: 깊이 잠들어서 숨을 크게 쉬는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
zzz.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when one makes a loud, breathing sound in deep sleep, or describing such a scene.

zzz.definitionKo: 깊이 자면서 숨을 쉬는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
zzz.englishDescription: A word imitating a breathing sound in deep sleep, or describing such a scene.
